scalars.scalar_value: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

A minimum of 1 year of experience working with high school students and counselors is preferred, but not required. The ability to speak a language other than English is also preferred, but not required. Experience at a liberal arts and sciences college is preferred.

The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday – Friday. Holiday, weekend and evening work hours will be required. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College or division.

items.item_text: A valid driver’s license is required or equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site meetings and events.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

A minimum of 1 year of experience working with high school students and counselors is preferred, but not required. The ability to speak a language other than English is also preferred, but not required. Experience at a liberal arts and sciences college is preferred.
1. Read, evaluate and rate applicant admission materials to make appropriate recommendations to the Admissions Selection Committee and meet the College’s annual enrollment goals.
a. Holistically review first-year and transfer applications using the Pomona College Office of Admissions criteria.
b. Evaluate academic records across curricula and contexts.
c. Assess non-academic components within geographic and educational context.
d. Prepare concise written evaluations and present cases in committee.
e. Apply policies consistently, meet deadlines, and uphold confidentiality.
2. Holistically review ninth grade applications for the Pomona College Academy for Youth Success (PAYS) summer program.
3. Support campus-based programs throughout the contract term.
a. Assist with planning and programming for Transfer Open House.
b. Assist with planning and programming for Admitted Students Day.

c. Provide support for daily visit operations for the Office of Admissions, which may include greeting visitors, presenting information sessions, and answering questions as the Officer of the Day (OD).
4. Provide input and feedback on the functioning of admissions programs and initiatives through regular staff meetings and staff development days.
5. Co-manage the Slate Inbox with a group of colleagues to distribute admissions inquiry emails to the correct person(s) in the Admissions Office.
6. Coordinate special projects/tasks and provide assistance as assigned, which may include local travel within Southern California.
